First and foremost a shield, but the bladed edges can deal slashing attacks when deflecting.|Inventory|TotK}} Lynel Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 30 |durability = 12 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Lynel Shield}} Lynel Shields are [[Shield]]s favored by [[Lynel]]s for both their defensive and offensive capabilities. While they are primarily useful as Shields, their edges are capable of dealing slash attacks that do 7 damage while deflecting. They belong to the [[Lynel Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s created by and for Lynels.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} Regular Lynels predominately use Lynel Shields, however [[Blue-Maned Lynel]]s in [[Master Mode]] will use them instead. They can become scarce as Lynels tier up, but since the Lynel on [[Ploymus Mountain]] will always remain a regular Lynel, it will always be a source of Lynel Shields. Being made of metal, Lynel Shields will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s. They will also sink if they are dropped in water. However, they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]], and they will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_016" |Life = 12 |GuardPower = 30 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 2 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 3 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 3 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 8 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 13 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 30 |durability = 12 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Lynel Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Lynel Shields reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Lynel Shields can be wielded by [[Link]] in conjunction with [[Lynel Sword]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Lynel Gear * Mighty Lynel Shield * Savage Lynel Shield * Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Lynel Gear, Shields |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
